document.name: PI360ApiWorkflows
document.title: Program Integrity 360 Case Lifecycle API Contracts

script.code:
const prepared = $context.outputs.PrepareLifecycleRequest;
return { workflowName: prepared.workflowName, caseType: prepared.caseType, caseId: prepared.caseId, status: 'Open', gated: false, recordsAffected: 1, persistedCaseId: prepared.caseId, registrationMode: 'Created', message: 'Program Integrity case registration created.', payload: { caseType: prepared.caseType, nextStageId: 'Stage_Evcol2', requesterEmail: prepared.requesterEmail, maestroInstanceId: prepared.maestroInstanceId || null } };

const prepared = $context.outputs.PrepareLifecycleRequest;
return { workflowName: prepared.workflowName, caseType: prepared.caseType, caseId: prepared.caseId, status: 'Completed', gated: false, recordsAffected: 2, persistedCaseId: prepared.caseId, registrationMode: 'EvidencePersisted', message: 'Hospital evidence and audit action persisted to Data Fabric.', payload: { nextStageId: 'Stage_Corr4a', documentId: prepared.evidenceRecord.doc_id } };

const prepared = $context.outputs.PrepareLifecycleRequest;
return { workflowName: prepared.workflowName, caseType: prepared.caseType, caseId: prepared.caseId, status: 'Closed', gated: false, recordsAffected: 3, persistedCaseId: prepared.caseId, registrationMode: 'Closed', message: 'Decision, closure audit action, and final case state persisted to Data Fabric.', payload: { finalStage: 8, finalStatus: 4, disposition: prepared.closePatch.disposition } };
throw new Error('No persistence route matched the requested lifecycle operation.');
